commits.subject: press (SMB-PRESS-PAINT-TRANSPARENCY): transparency groups and soft masks in the paint device

capabilities_done: paint.rs transparency groups as offscreen layers (clean-room from ISO 32000-1 11.3-11.6): basic compositing formula 11.3.3 with shape and opacity kept apart; group alpha tracked apart from the backdrop; non-isolated groups start from the backdrop (enclosing layer or opaque page) and remove its contribution at the end with the 11.4.8 formula C = Cn + (Cn - C0) x (a0/agn - a0); knockout groups composite each element against the initial backdrop weighted by its shape (11.4.6.2, premultiplied); group result composited with group opacity, group soft mask, blend mode and the clip in force

soft masks (11.6.5): ExtGState masks (applied to later draws) and group masks rendered by interpreting the mask group into a dedicated layer over /BC (luminosity: 0.30 R + 0.59 G + 0.11 B) or transparent (alpha: group alpha), then /TR; cached per mask and bounds (16)
non-separable blend modes Hue, Saturation, Color, Luminosity (11.3.5.3 Lum / ClipColor / SetLum / Sat / SetSat) replace the old Normal approximation

hostile groups: nesting deeper than MAX_GROUP_DEPTH 32 and layers over the layer memory cap (min(4 canvases x 36 bytes, 512 MiB)) are refused BEFORE allocation (Dead layer, content not drawn, WorkBudget note, pops stay balanced); a soft mask that cannot be built leaves its content undrawn (SoftMask note)

render_page passes the document's transparency-group /I and /K flags to the device (hayro-interpret 0.7.0 reports groups without them; soft-mask groups excluded); differing flags in one file -> ISO defaults + note group_flags_mixed; RenderedPage.notes
export SoftMask gains alpha (/S /Alpha), backdrop (/BC gray), transfer_exponent (/TR type-2 function) + SoftMask::luminosity; typed refusals colour_out_of_range, value_out_of_range, non_finite
